properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 (SHA-1/SHA-2 JS implementations) is a transitive dev-toolchain dependency declared in package-lock.json (required by elliptic@6.5.2 and by ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3, which ganache-cli bundles). No first-party call site — the application's own hashing is the Solidity sha256 precompile in contracts/*.sol plus Node's built-in crypto in test/helper/utils.js. Changeable here (lockfile edit).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-js@3.3.0 ships MD5 and is declared transitively in package-lock.json via the truffle/ganache dev toolchain. No first-party code invokes MD5; it is recorded because the installed toolchain ships the algorithm. Changeable here (lockfile edit).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-js@3.3.0 ships SHA-1 and is declared transitively in package-lock.json via the truffle/ganache dev toolchain. No first-party call site; the algorithm ships with the installed toolchain. Changeable here (lockfile edit).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: evp_bytestokey (OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey — MD5-based, single-round) ships in the locked truffle/ganache dev-toolchain tree; no application call site — the app's only JS crypto uses Node's built-in crypto module directly. Changeable here by pruning devDependencies.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: bcrypt-based PBKDF shipped in the locked dev tree (tweetnacl uses it for box key derivation); no application call site. Not Shor-vulnerable — password KDF with Grover-reduced margin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: Node/browserify ECDH shim ships with the locked truffle toolchain; no application call site. Classical ECDH is retroactively breakable (harvest-now-decrypt-later) if the toolchain's key agreement is ever exercised.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Available in the shipped dependency tree (tweetnacl pulled via bcrypt-pbkdf and sshpk chains in the truffle/ganache toolchain); no application call site — a sweep of every source .js found zero tweetnacl usage. Classical signature primitive: deadline-class migration to ML-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: elliptic@6.5.2 implements ECDSA (P-256/secp256k1/Ed25519) and is a transitive dev-toolchain dependency declared in package-lock.json. No direct first-party call site; ECDSA over secp256k1 is what truffle/ganache use internally to sign dev-account transactions on the local test chain. Companion library entry: LIB-a0bfbc1a. Changeable here (lockfile edit).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Available in the shipped tree via tweetnacl; no application call site in this repo's source. Classical key agreement — retroactive risk class; presence matters because the toolchain could exercise it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: memory-hard password KDF shipping in the locked dev tree (ethereumjs-util/ganache keystore path); no application call site. Not Shor-vulnerable; presence inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-js 3.3.0 (2016-era release) ships in the locked dev tree; no application call site. Its default KDF is the single-round MD5 EVP_BytesToKey already recorded as ALG-97a780a0.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The JS mirror of the contracts' on-chain SHA-256 hashlock: mints a 32-byte random preimage and its SHA-256 digest so sha256(preimage)==hashlock holds in the HTLC. SHA-256 is Grover-reduced to ~128-bit PQ preimage resistance — still adequate, inventoried for posture. Test-harness asset mirroring production logic.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Strong classical AEAD shipped in the dependency tree via tweetnacl; no application call site. Presence inventory — the primitive itself is robust (256-bit keys, Grover margin only).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider shipped with the build's locked tree; zero application call sites (a sweep of all source .js found no tweetnacl usage). Carries Ed25519, X25519 and XSalsa20-Poly1305, recorded under the sibling ALG objects. Observable here, replaceable only by pruning the toolchain that pulls it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider in the shipped tree; no application call site (sweep of all source .js found zero crypto-js/CryptoJS usage). Its AES/MD5/EVP_BytesToKey surface is recorded under the sibling ALG objects. Observable here; only removable by pruning the dev toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Posture control done right: Node's CSPRNG generates the 256-bit secrets whose SHA-256 digests become the on-chain hashlocks — the preimage secrets are not weakly generated. Not quantum-relevant; kept for inventory completeness.
